biography_english:
A Bakram formerly with the Liberation Front. He was at sea when the Dark Knights attacked Boed Fortress to wipe out the Liberation Front, and so escaped with his life. After meeting up with Cerya at Rhime, they set out for Qadriga Fortress. They continued the work of the Liberation Front under the guise of pirates, calling themselves the "Free Seas."
  Ehlrig joined the Resistance for a time, but was later dismissed by {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Un bakram que pertenecio al Frente de Liberacion. Estaba en el mar cuando los Caballeros Oscuros atacaron la Fortaleza de Boed para exterminar al Frente, por lo que salvo la vida. Tras reunirse con Cerya en Rhime, partieron a la Fortaleza de Qadriga. Continuaron la labor del Frente bajo la apariencia de piratas, llamandose los "Mares Libres".
  Ehlrig se unio a la Resistencia un tiempo, pero despues fue expulsado por {hero}.

biography_english:
An offspring of the gryphon Berda raised by the Beastmaster Ganpp. Though still young in gryphon years and smaller than Berda in stature, his intelligence and strength far surpass his peers.
  He is usually irritable around anyone but Ganpp, jabbing his beak at those who stray too close. A peck from him is more than enough to keep unwanted company at a distance.
biography_spanish:
Cria del grifon Berda criada por el adiestrador Ganpp. Aun joven en anos de grifon y mas pequeno que Berda en estatura, su inteligencia y fuerza superan por mucho a las de sus iguales.
  Suele ser irritable con cualquiera que no sea Ganpp, arremetiendo su pico contra quien se acerque demasiado. Un picotazo suyo basta para mantener lejos a las visitas indeseadas.

biography_english:
A Walister serving with the Order of {order}. She is an archer with the Knights of Almorica. Her father and brothers were also bowmen with the knights, but all perished in the early days of the war. Her pinpoint accuracy with the bow more than compensates for her lack of brute strength.
  She returned to her mother's side after the defeat of the Walister and the capture of Duke Ronwey. However, she returned to her post as soon as she received word of the Duke's rescue.
  She initially served with Leonar's troops, but then joined the Order of {order} after {hero} went to her aid at Krysaro.
biography_spanish:
Una walister que sirve en la Orden de {order}. Es una arquera de los Caballeros de Almorica. Su padre y sus hermanos tambien eran arqueros de los caballeros, pero todos perecieron al principio de la guerra. Su precision impecable con el arco compensa con creces su falta de fuerza bruta.
  Regreso junto a su madre tras la derrota walister y la captura del duque Ronwey. Sin embargo, volvio a su puesto tan pronto como supo del rescate del duque.
  Sirvio primero a las ordenes de Leonar, pero se unio a la Orden de {order} luego de que {hero} acudiera a socorrerla en Krysaro.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from the town of Sezhun in Almorica who serves in the Order of {order}.
  House Montrose is a noble family that has produced a great many knights over the years, and they are known for their loyalty to the duke. They live by the motto, "Serve with each sweep of the blade."
  When Leonar was made leader of the duke's personal troops, Voltare was appointed his second in command. His steadfast nature and closeness in age to Leonar forged a strong bond between them.
  Following the recapture of Almorica Castle, he met with ambush while pursuing the Necromancer Nybeth with Leonar. After {hero} came to their rescue, he left Leonar's side and became a member of the Order of {order}.
biography_spanish:
Un walister de la villa de Sezhun, en Almorica, que sirve en la Orden de {order}.
  La casa Montrose es una familia noble que ha dado muchos caballeros con los anos, y destaca por su lealtad al duque. Viven bajo el lema: "Servir con cada tajo de la espada".
  Cuando nombraron a Leonar lider de las tropas personales del duque, designaron a Voltare su segundo al mando. Su caracter firme y su edad cercana a la de Leonar crearon un fuerte vinculo entre ellos.
  Tras la reconquista del castillo de Almorica, cayo en una emboscada mientras perseguia al nigromante Nybeth con Leonar. Despues de que {hero} acudiera a rescatarlos, dejo el lado de Leonar y paso a formar parte de la Orden de {order}.

biography_english:
A Walister serving in the Order of {order}. She was raised at an abbey on the outskirts of Almorica, eventually becoming a sibyl of Philaha. Her parents also served the order, but were slain by the Galgastani while en route to provide aid to those suffering in Krysaro. Hearing of Duke Ronwey's liberation, she defied the opposition of her superiors and joined the Walister Resistance.
  She first served under Sir Leonar's command, but then joined the Order of {order} after {hero} went to her aid at Krysaro.

Sus padres servian a la orden, pero los galgastanies los mataron al ir a ayudar a los que sufrian en Krysaro. Al saber de la liberacion del duque Ronwey, desoyo a sus superiores y se unio a la Resistencia walister.
  Sirvio con sir Leonar, pero se unio a la Orden de {order} tras recibir la ayuda de {hero} en Krysaro.
